_meta.note: Standard Igbo (Igbo Izugbe) in the neutral public-information register of Nigerian health communication; the dotted letters ị ọ ụ ṅ are written and tone marks are omitted except in mgbaàmà (symptom), which keeps it apart from ihe ịrịba ama (signal). Severity levels form one ordered scale used everywhere — Enweghị ihe akaebe ugbu a < Nche < Karịrị nkịtị < Dị elu < Dị oke njọ — and confidence uses Dị ala / Nọ n'etiti / Dị elu / Dị ala nke ukwuu (the dashboard shares one 'High' string between severity and confidence, always shown after 'Ọkwa 3 ·' or 'Ntụkwasị obi:'). A case is onye ọrịa: confirmed = a kwadoro (laboratory-confirmed = ụlọ nyocha kwadoro), probable = o yikarịrị (na ha bụ ndị ọrịa), suspected = a na-enyo enyo (na ha bụ ndị ọrịa). Official = nke ndị ọchịchị (health authorities, national or international), unofficial = na-abụghị nke ndị ọchịchị; estimate = atụmatụ (estimated = a tụrụ atụ), always distinct from official figures (ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ọchịchị); model = usoro mgbakọ; forecast and prediction = amụma, while scenario = ọnọdụ e chepụtara ('an imagined situation') so that 'scenario, not a prediction' stays explicit; outbreak = ntiwapụ ọrịa; transmission = mgbasa ọrịa; surveillance = nleba anya; alert = ịdọ aka na ntị; synthetic test data = data nnwale. 'Not a medical service' is rendered 'ọ bụghị ọrụ ọgwụgwọ ndị ọrịa' (not a service that treats patients). Loanwords common in Nigerian Igbo are used for technical items (data, saịtị, peeji, maapụ, faịlụ, tebụl), numbers follow the noun as in Igbo (ụbọchị 21), and technical names without an established Igbo term are kept in English in brackets (diagnosis, nowcast, calibration, prior, renewal, log-linear).

Ebola Watch enweghị ike inye ndụmọdụ ọgwụgwọ. Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ nwere ike ịrịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ nwee ike ịbụ na ọ nọ n'ihe ize ndụ ibute ya, kpọtụrụ onye ọrụ ahụike, ụlọ ọgwụ, ma ọ bụ ndị ọchịchị ahụike ọha nke mba gị ma ọ bụ nọmba ekwentị enyemaka Ebola.
ui.Ebola Watch does not diagnose, recommend: Ebola Watch anaghị achọpụta ọrịa mmadụ nwere (diagnosis), anaghị atụ aro ọgwụgwọ, ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ọgwụ mgbochi, anaghịkwa enyocha mgbaàmà ọrịa onye ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ nwere ike ịrịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ nọ n'ihe ize ndụ ibute ya, kpọtụrụ onye ọrụ ahụike ma ọ bụ ndị ọchịchị ahụike ọha nke mba gị.
ui.Ebola Watch is written in English. The i: E dere Ebola Watch n'asụsụ Bekee. Ihe ngosi saịtị ahụ, na nkọwa, ịdọ aka na ntị na akụkọ a na-emepụta na-akpaghị aka, dịkwa n'asụsụ ndị dị n'okpuru. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe asụsụ n'elu peeji ọ bụla.
ui.Ebola Watch never silently combines thes: Ebola Watch anaghị ejikọ otu ndị a ọnụ na nzuzo, a naghịkwa egosi atụmatụ usoro mgbakọ dịka ndị ọrịa a kwadoro.
ui.Ebola Watch provides epidemiological obs: Ebola Watch na-enye nleba anya na mgbasa ọrịa (epidemiology), atụmatụ ibu ọrịa, amụma na ozi gbasara ahụike ọha. Ọ bụghị ọrụ ọgwụgwọ ndị ọrịa, ọ naghịkwa enye nchọpụta ọrịa (diagnosis), ọgwụgwọ, ọgwụ, ọgwụ mgbochi ma ọ bụ ndụmọdụ ọgwụgwọ ọ bụla ọzọ. Atụmatụ na amụma enweghị nkwenye zuru oke, a gaghịkwa eji ha mee mkpebi gbasara nlekọta ahụike onye ọ bụla.
